name: Venture Co. Documents
summary: In eastern Mulgore, Venture Co. Documents confirm illegal strip-mining in tauren lands. The papers were recovered from a crate amid a ruined caravan and detail the company's operations.

sections.title: Evidence of Exploitation
sections.body: Venture Co. Documents were found atop mined ore in a ransacked wagon. The ledgers show the goblin-led cartel has quietly established drilling and mining outposts in Mulgore's eastern foothills. Across Kalimdor, the Venture Company is known for ruthless deforestation and uncontrolled excavation. Morin Cloudstalker and the tauren Outrunners use the seized records to judge the threat to their sacred ancestral plains and rally hunters to drive out the trespassers.

faq.q: What do the Venture Co. Documents contain?
faq.answer: The papers detail the Venture Company's mining and extraction in eastern Mulgore. They reveal the goblin enterprise is harvesting and carrying away the region's mineral wealth.

aliases: where do i find the documents
faq.answer: The papers were found in a sealed Venture Company crate amid a ransacked wagon's wreckage at the Ravaged Caravan site, east of Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Who needs to see these papers?
aliases: who do i bring documents to
faq.answer: Bring the papers to Morin Cloudstalker, a tauren hunter stationed along the main trail east of Bloodhoof Village. He watches over Mulgore's security.

faq.q: Why are the Venture Company mining in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Venture Company mines for profit, seeking rich mineral veins and untamed territories to strip of valuable ores. It has zero regard for native treaties, spiritual customs, or the environment.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know goblin machinery defiles the Earth Mother's sacred earth. These papers help the elders confirm the desecration's extent and launch retaliatory strikes.
As a miner, you can see why the raw mineral samples packed beside the papers matter: they show that the foothills hold rich, untapped veins ripe for excavation.
